items.t: Said he supported the federal stimulus package, the American Recovery and Reinvestment Act, at a town hall with President Barack Obama in Ft. Myers (2009).
items.q: Tuesday, I joined President Barack Obama for a town hall meeting in Ft. Myers to discuss with Floridians the American Recovery and Reinvestment Act. During the town hall, I reiterated my support for the federal stimulus package.

items.t: Said the trade embargo against Cuba should be ended, in a speech in Miami's Little Havana as a Democratic candidate for governor.
items.q: the Democratic candidate for governor stood before a crowd and said what few politicians have in decades of scrounging for votes in the Cuban-American neighborhood: End the trade embargo against Cuba.
